preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some LPP tokens to demonstrate the fee impact

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call changeBurnFee() with parameters that set the burn fee to an excessively high value (e.g., _newburnFee = 9900, _newburnDivisor = 100). Then perform a token transfer to another address (not excluded from fees) to demonstrate the economic impact - the recipient will lose a large percentage of transferred tokens to burning, effectively reducing circulating supply and increasing the attacker's relative token value.
